transcript.en_text: I'm glad you brought up nepotism, Senator.
transcript.zh_text: 参议员，我很高兴你提到了裙带关系。

transcript.en_text: Um, if this were an outright appointment, that would be one thing, but in this case, the president can only nominate.
transcript.zh_text: 嗯，如果这是一次直接任命，那是一回事，但就目前而言，总统只能提名。

transcript.en_text: It's the Senate that deems me worthy.
transcript.zh_text: 是参议院认为我值得。

transcript.en_text: I'm here to convince you that I am.
transcript.zh_text: 我来这里就是要说服你们我确实值得。

transcript.en_text: Although, I must admit, my husband never remembers to put the toilet seat down, so he could be trying to make it up to me.
transcript.zh_text: 虽然我必须承认，我丈夫总是忘了把马桶盖放下来，所以他可能是在试图补偿我。

transcript.en_text: My larger concern is your experience.
transcript.zh_text: 我更主要的顾虑是你的经验。

transcript.en_text: You have very little.
transcript.zh_text: 你经验很少。

transcript.en_text: Well, a decade ago, I founded a small nonprofit and I built it into a major global player.
transcript.zh_text: 嗯，十年前，我创办了一家小型非营利组织，并将其发展成为一个主要的全球参与者。

transcript.en_text: I shepherded a number of bills through Congress on its behalf.
transcript.zh_text: 我代表该组织，促成了多项法案在国会通过。

transcript.en_text: And over the last year, I've dedicated myself to sexual assault reform, and have made meaningful strides.
transcript.zh_text: 在过去一年里，我致力于性侵犯改革，并取得了有意义的进展。

transcript.en_text: Now, while this may not qualify as statecraft, it does illustrate my effectiveness, the same effectiveness I plan on bringing to the United Nations.
transcript.zh_text: 虽然这可能算不上是治国之道，但它确实说明了我的效率，这也是我打算带到联合国去的效率。

transcript.en_text: Thank you, Mrs.
transcript.zh_text: 谢谢，夫人。

transcript.en_text: Underwood.
transcript.zh_text: 安德伍德。

transcript.en_text: I yield the remainder of my time.
transcript.zh_text: 我放弃我剩余的时间。

transcript.en_text: Uh, Mrs.
transcript.zh_text: 呃，夫人。

transcript.en_text: Wallace of North Dakota, you have eight minutes.
transcript.zh_text: 北达科他州的华莱士夫人，你有八分钟。

transcript.en_text: Thank you, Mr.
transcript.zh_text: 谢谢你，先生。

transcript.en_text: Chairman.
transcript.zh_text: 主席。

transcript.en_text: Mrs.
transcript.zh_text: 夫人。

transcript.en_text: Underwood, allow me to get specific.
transcript.zh_text: 安德伍德，请允许我具体说明一下。

transcript.en_text: What is your take on UN Resolution 9214, the imposition of sanctions on the Congo for the-- The illegal mining and smuggling of mineral resources.
transcript.zh_text: 你对联合国第9214号决议有什么看法？该决议对刚果实施制裁，理由是非法采矿和走私矿产资源。

transcript.en_text: Yes.
transcript.zh_text: 是的。

transcript.en_text: The United States voted against this resolution.
transcript.zh_text: 美国投票反对这项决议。

transcript.en_text: The DRC is already wracked with economic hardship, compounded by an unstable government.
transcript.zh_text: 刚果民主共和国已经饱受经济困境的折磨，再加上政府不稳定，情况更加恶化。

transcript.en_text: It ranks 192 out of 194 in GDP per capita.
transcript.zh_text: 按人均国内生产总值计算，它在194个国家中排名第192位。

transcript.en_text: I think we need to encourage foreign investment and develop new forms of economic growth rather than make one of the world's poorest countries even poorer.
transcript.zh_text: 我认为我们需要鼓励外国投资，发展新的经济增长模式，而不是让世界上最贫穷的国家之一变得更加贫穷。

transcript.en_text: From a national security perspective, the United States maintains a strong interest in the success of the DRC.
transcript.zh_text: 从国家安全的角度来看，美国对刚果民主共和国的成功抱有浓厚兴趣。

transcript.en_text: - We want a stable nation... - They're here.
transcript.zh_text: —— 我们需要一个稳定的国家…… —— 他们来了。

transcript.en_text: ...that can help us in combating the spread of Islamic radicalism throughout the continent.
transcript.zh_text: ……可以帮助我们打击伊斯兰激进主义在整个非洲大陆的蔓延。

transcript.en_text: And in order to achieve that, we need to work as its ally, not its disciplinarian.
transcript.zh_text: 为了实现这一点，我们需要作为它的盟友而不是它的训导者来合作。

transcript.en_text: Good morning.
transcript.zh_text: 早上好。

transcript.en_text: Mr.
transcript.zh_text: 先生。

transcript.en_text: President.
transcript.zh_text: 总统。

transcript.en_text: Jackie.
transcript.zh_text: 杰姬。

transcript.en_text: Terry.
transcript.zh_text: 特里。

transcript.en_text: Shall we?
transcript.zh_text: 我们走吧？

transcript.en_text: Now you all have the, uh... overview.
transcript.zh_text: 现在你们都有了，呃……概况。

transcript.en_text: But what we have here today - is the comprehensive breakdown-- - Sir, before we begin-- Look, Bob, I know you have some serious doubts about this program.
transcript.zh_text: 但我们今天在这里——是关于全面的细目—— 先生，在我们开始之前—— 鲍勃，我知道你对这个项目有一些严重的疑虑。

transcript.en_text: But just let me flesh it out first, and then I promise we can address any questions that you might have.
transcript.zh_text: 但请先让我把它充实起来，然后我保证我们可以解决你可能有的任何问题。

transcript.en_text: - Uh, Mr.
transcript.zh_text: - 呃，先生。

transcript.en_text: President-- - Ten million jobs.
transcript.zh_text: 总统—— - 一千万个工作岗位。

transcript.en_text: Can we all agree that that's a good thing for this country?
transcript.zh_text: 我们都能同意这对国家是件好事，对吗？

transcript.en_text: Universal employment.
transcript.zh_text: 全民就业。

transcript.en_text: It's the key for our keeping the White House in 2016.
transcript.zh_text: 这是我们2016年保住白宫的关键。

transcript.en_text: It's the only chance we have of winning back majorities in Congress.
transcript.zh_text: 这是我们在国会赢回多数席位的唯一机会。

transcript.en_text: Now, the election's only 18 months away.
transcript.zh_text: 现在，离大选只剩18个月了。

transcript.en_text: We need to do something bold, something decisive.
transcript.zh_text: 我们需要采取大胆果断的行动。

transcript.en_text: We need to redefine our party.
transcript.zh_text: 我们需要重新定义我们的党派。

transcript.en_text: Actually, that's what we wanted to discuss.
transcript.zh_text: 实际上，这正是我们想讨论的。

transcript.en_text: You're right, we do need to redefine the party.
transcript.zh_text: 你说的对，我们确实需要重新定义这个党派。

transcript.en_text: We need to do it with a fresh face.
transcript.zh_text: 我们需要一个新面孔来做这件事。

transcript.en_text: We don't want you to run.
transcript.zh_text: 我们不希望你参选。

transcript.en_text: You weren't even elected to the office in the first place.
transcript.zh_text: 你当初甚至都不是通过选举上任的。

transcript.en_text: The pardons hurt you.
transcript.zh_text: 那些赦免损害了你的声誉。

transcript.en_text: Approvals are low.
transcript.zh_text: 支持率很低。

transcript.en_text: We're not casting blame, sir.
transcript.zh_text: 我们不是在责怪你，先生。

transcript.en_text: We just believe that this is best for the party.
transcript.zh_text: 我们只是认为这对党派最好。

transcript.en_text: I suspected this was coming, but months from now.
transcript.zh_text: 我预料到会发生这种事，但以为会是几个月之后。

transcript.en_text: I was hoping by then I'd have something to show for my efforts, that I could preempt their doubts with progress.
transcript.zh_text: 我希望到那时我的努力能有所成果，这样我就可以用进展来消除他们的疑虑。

transcript.en_text: They're nervous.
transcript.zh_text: 他们很紧张。

transcript.en_text: They're being impulsive.
transcript.zh_text: 他们太冲动了。

transcript.en_text: It's a bit early to be deciding something like this.
transcript.zh_text: 现在决定这样的事情有点早了。

transcript.en_text: Shouldn't we revisit this when we're closer to the primaries?
transcript.zh_text: 我们是不是应该等初选临近的时候再讨论这个问题？

transcript.en_text: What do you think, Terry?
transcript.zh_text: 特里，你觉得呢？

transcript.en_text: Like you said, sir, we only have 18 months until the general.
transcript.zh_text: 就像您说的，先生，我们离大选只剩下18个月了。

transcript.en_text: Less than half of that to Iowa.
transcript.zh_text: 离爱荷华州（初选）的时间还不到一半。

transcript.en_text: We would want to settle on a candidate soon.
transcript.zh_text: 我们想尽快确定一位候选人。

transcript.en_text: Someone who the whole party can get behind like the Republicans are getting behind Mendoza.
transcript.zh_text: 一个能得到全党支持的人，就像共和党支持门多萨一样。

transcript.en_text: And who would that be?
transcript.zh_text: 那会是谁呢？

transcript.en_text: We haven't had a discussion on that yet.
transcript.zh_text: 我们还没讨论过这个问题。

transcript.en_text: We came to you first, out of respect.
transcript.zh_text: 我们是出于尊重，才首先来找您。

transcript.en_text: - Well, there must be a shortlist. - No, not yet.
transcript.zh_text: - 嗯，肯定有候选名单吧。- 不，还没有。

transcript.en_text: It'll be a process to find the right person.
transcript.zh_text: 找到合适的人会是一个过程。

transcript.en_text: And we were hoping that you would be a part of that process.
transcript.zh_text: 我们也希望您能参与到这个过程中来。

transcript.en_text: Obviously, this is a request, Mr.
transcript.zh_text: 显然，这是一项请求，先生。

transcript.en_text: President.
transcript.zh_text: 总统。

transcript.en_text: It's your decision.
transcript.zh_text: 这是您的决定。

transcript.en_text: But if you do run, sir, you won't have our support.
transcript.zh_text: 但如果您真的参选，先生，您将得不到我们的支持。

transcript.en_text: Jackie?
transcript.zh_text: 杰姬？

transcript.en_text: I stand by the rest of the leadership.
transcript.zh_text: 我支持其他领导层的决定。

transcript.en_text: Well, this is certainly a lot to think about.
transcript.zh_text: 嗯，这确实有很多值得深思的地方。

transcript.en_text: Let's table our discussion on America Works for another time, but thank you all for being so forthright.
transcript.zh_text: 关于“美国就业计划”的讨论，我们先搁置一下，改日再议。但感谢各位如此坦诚。

transcript.en_text: I'll get back to you on this issue a little later on.
transcript.zh_text: 我会稍后就此事回复你们。

transcript.en_text: Would you like us to stick around for a while?
transcript.zh_text: 你们想再待一会儿吗？

transcript.en_text: We wouldn't want the press to think we came all the way here - for a five-minute meeting. - That's a very good idea.
transcript.zh_text: 我们可不希望媒体认为我们大老远跑来——只开了个五分钟的会。——这是个好主意。

transcript.en_text: No raised eyebrows.
transcript.zh_text: 不要引起任何疑虑/惊讶。

transcript.en_text: I'll have some refreshments sent for you into the Map Room.
transcript.zh_text: 我会让人给你们送些茶点到地图室。

transcript.en_text: Wonderful.
transcript.zh_text: 太好了。

transcript.en_text: Thank you, Mr.
transcript.zh_text: 谢谢，先生。

transcript.en_text: President.
transcript.zh_text: 总统。

transcript.en_text: As a vocal proponent for the Sexual Assault Bill last session, are you concerned about your relationship with the US military?
transcript.zh_text: 作为上一届会议《性侵法案》的积极倡导者，您是否担心自己与美国军方的关系？

transcript.en_text: No, I'm not, Senator.
transcript.zh_text: 不，我不担心，参议员。

transcript.en_text: I worked closely with the Joint Chiefs on that bill.
transcript.zh_text: 我与参谋长联席会议就那项法案密切合作过。

transcript.en_text: What if there were a peacekeeping mission in, say, Burma, to quell civil unrest, and the United Nations asked us to contribute troops, to put our servicemen and women's lives in peril.
transcript.zh_text: 如果联合国要求我们在缅甸进行维和任务，以平息内乱，并要求我们派遣部队，将我们的军人的生命置于危险之中，那怎么办？

transcript.en_text: If you're using Myanmar as a hypothetical, I think we're a long way from that, but as Ambassador-- My question concerns the use of US military.
transcript.zh_text: 如果你把缅甸作为假设，我认为我们离那一步还很远，但作为大使——我的问题是关于美国军方的使用。

transcript.en_text: The US military is irrelevant.
transcript.zh_text: 美国军方与此无关。

transcript.en_text: The current situation-- Excuse me, Mrs.
transcript.zh_text: 目前的情况——抱歉，夫人。

transcript.en_text: Underwood.
transcript.zh_text: 安德伍德夫人。

transcript.en_text: The US military is irrelevant?
transcript.zh_text: 美国军队无关紧要吗？

transcript.en_text: Well, I-- That's not what I said.
transcript.zh_text: 嗯，我——我没那么说。

transcript.en_text: You said verbatim: "The US military is irrelevant." Well, in the, in the context of-- I meant... uh, that there are plenty--
transcript.zh_text: 你逐字逐句地说：“美国军队无关紧要。”嗯，在……在这种情况下——我的意思是……呃，有很多——

transcript.en_text: I have the utmost respect and appreciation for our troops, sir.
transcript.zh_text: 我对我们的部队怀有崇高的敬意和赞赏，先生。

transcript.en_text: Not with statements like that, you don't.
transcript.zh_text: 像那样的话，你当然没有。

transcript.en_text: Senator, if I may, I can explain.
transcript.zh_text: 参议员，如果可以的话，我可以解释。

transcript.en_text: How do we explain to the men and women who serve, who put their lives on the line, that our ambassador thinks they're irrelevant?
transcript.zh_text: 我们如何向那些服役、那些冒着生命危险的人解释，我们的 L大使认为他们无关紧要？

highlights.en_word: put their lives on the line

transcript.en_text: I think that's an unfair characterization of what I intended-- I am not characterizing anything, Mrs.
transcript.zh_text: 我认为那对我本意是一种不公平的描述——我没有描述任何东西，夫人。

transcript.en_text: Underwood, you said the words.
transcript.zh_text: 安德伍德夫人，那些话是你说的。

transcript.en_text: And now you're trying to backpedal your way out of it.
transcript.zh_text: 而你现在正试图为此找借口推卸责任。

highlights.en_word: backpedal your way out of it

transcript.en_text: - You're trying to take my words-- - Don't interrupt me.
transcript.zh_text: - 你想歪曲我的话—— - 不要打断我。

transcript.en_text: If you will stop interrupting me, I can explain-- No, you see, we ask the questions, you answer them.
transcript.zh_text: 如果你不再打断我，我就可以解释——不，你看，我们提问，你回答。

transcript.en_text: You're not allowing me to answer the questions, Senator.
transcript.zh_text: 参议员，您不让我回答问题。

transcript.en_text: If you could maybe listen instead of grandstanding.
transcript.zh_text: 如果你能倾听，而不是哗众取宠。

transcript.en_text: The position you're being considered for requires calm, cool diplomacy.
transcript.zh_text: 你正在被考虑的这个职位需要冷静、沉着的外交手腕。

transcript.en_text: What concerns me even more than the military comment is your demeanor.
transcript.zh_text: 比军事评论更让我担忧的是你的举止。

transcript.en_text: Is this what we're to expect from our ambassador?
transcript.zh_text: 这就是我们对我们大使的期望吗？

transcript.en_text: A hothead?
transcript.zh_text: 一个鲁莽的人？

transcript.en_text: Go ahead, Mrs.
transcript.zh_text: 请说，夫人。

transcript.en_text: Underwood, I'm listening.
transcript.zh_text: 安德伍德夫人，我正在听。

transcript.en_text: Maybe it's leverage for another play.
transcript.zh_text: 也许这是为了另一场博弈的筹码。

transcript.en_text: Scare the wits out of me and then come with the big ask.
transcript.zh_text: 先把我吓得魂飞魄散，然后提出这么大的要求。

highlights.en_word: Scare the wits out of me

transcript.en_text: - You sure there is one? - America Works.
transcript.zh_text: - 你确定有一个吗？ - “美国工作”计划。

transcript.en_text: They want to kill it.
transcript.zh_text: 他们想扼杀它。

transcript.en_text: Or soften me up to consider another VP candidate for the ticket.
transcript.zh_text: 或者想让我软化立场，考虑另一位副总统候选人来竞选。

transcript.en_text: They're no fans of Blythe.
transcript.zh_text: 他们不喜欢布莱斯。

transcript.en_text: Could be anything, any combination of things.
transcript.zh_text: 可能是任何事，任何情况的组合。

transcript.en_text: - What? - You saw it?
transcript.zh_text: - 什么？ - 你看到了吗？

transcript.en_text: - Saw what? - The First Lady, sir.
transcript.zh_text: - 看到什么了？ - 总统夫人，先生。

transcript.en_text: - Jesus.
transcript.zh_text: - 天哪。

transcript.en_text: I better call her. - She's still in the hearing, sir.
transcript.zh_text: 我最好给她打电话。 - 她还在听证会，先生。

transcript.en_text: I need to see this whole thing.
transcript.zh_text: 我需要看到整个事情经过。

transcript.en_text: Let's get ahead of it if we can.
transcript.zh_text: 如果可以的话，我们得提前应对。

transcript.en_text: - The Solicitor General is here. - Cancel it.
transcript.zh_text: - 司法部长在这里。 - 取消。

transcript.en_text: - You've already postponed twice. - Postpone it again.
transcript.zh_text: - 你已经推迟两次了。 - 再推迟一次。

transcript.en_text: We can't put it off, sir.
transcript.zh_text: 我们不能再拖延了，先生。

transcript.en_text: It goes to the Supreme Court in less than a month.
transcript.zh_text: 不到一个月它就要提交给最高法院了。

transcript.en_text: We have bigger fish to fry.
transcript.zh_text: 我们有更重要的事情要做。

transcript.en_text: An American citizen was injured by a drone strike.
transcript.zh_text: 一名美国公民在无人机袭击中受伤。

transcript.en_text: That Walker authorized, not me.
transcript.zh_text: 那是沃克授权的，不是我。

transcript.en_text: But you're the sitting president.
transcript.zh_text: 但你是现任总统。

transcript.en_text: If we lose this, it undermines your authority.
transcript.zh_text: 如果我们输了，就会损害你的权威。

transcript.en_text: The media is all over it.
transcript.zh_text: 媒体都在关注这件事。

transcript.en_text: We need our rhetoric in line with the Solicitor General's.
transcript.zh_text: 我们的措辞需要与司法部长的保持一致。

transcript.en_text: All right.
transcript.zh_text: 好吧。

transcript.en_text: Christ!
transcript.zh_text: 天哪！

transcript.en_text: Send her in.
transcript.zh_text: 让她进来。

transcript.en_text: I'll put this clip on your computer, for when you're done.
transcript.zh_text: 等你忙完，我把这个片段放到你电脑上。

transcript.en_text: Terry Womack.
transcript.zh_text: 特里·沃马克。

transcript.en_text: Today.
transcript.zh_text: 今天。

transcript.en_text: Privately.
transcript.zh_text: 私下里。

transcript.en_text: Ms.
transcript.zh_text: 女士。

transcript.en_text: Dunbar.
transcript.zh_text: 邓巴。

transcript.en_text: Before we begin, I'd like to clear the air.
transcript.zh_text: 在我们开始之前，我想把话说清楚。

transcript.en_text: Your report.
transcript.zh_text: 你的报告。

transcript.en_text: You did good work, necessary work, and I admire you for it.
transcript.zh_text: 你做得很好，工作也很必要，我很欣赏你。

transcript.en_text: I appreciate you saying that, sir.
transcript.zh_text: 谢谢你这么说，先生。

transcript.en_text: And you understand the position I was in with the pardons.
transcript.zh_text: 你也理解我在赦免问题上的处境。

transcript.en_text: That's politics, sir.
transcript.zh_text: 那是政治，先生。

transcript.en_text: Not my expertise.
transcript.zh_text: 那不是我的专长。

transcript.en_text: What's past is past?
transcript.zh_text: 过去的事情就让它过去吧？

highlights.zh_word: 过去的事情就让它过去吧

transcript.en_text: My focus is the argument I'll present to the court.
transcript.zh_text: 我的重点是我将向法庭提出的论点。

transcript.en_text: She sees me as the bank robber who made it to the county line.
transcript.zh_text: 她把我视为那个成功逃到县境的银行劫匪。

transcript.en_text: But she's smart enough to leave her badge at the door.
transcript.zh_text: 但她足够聪明，知道要把她的徽章留在门外。

highlights.en_word: leave her badge at the door

transcript.en_text: So, the case.
transcript.zh_text: 那么，这个案子。

transcript.en_text: As you know, sir, we think the State secret defense is strong.
transcript.zh_text: 先生，如您所知，我们认为国家机密辩护很强。

transcript.en_text: When I consulted with the CIA on the-- I'm wondering if State secrets is the best tactic.
transcript.zh_text: 当我与中情局就此事协商时——我在想国家机密是不是最好的策略。

transcript.en_text: Both of Mahmoud's legs were amputated.
transcript.zh_text: 马哈茂德的双腿都被截肢了。

transcript.en_text: He will be in the gallery, in his wheelchair.
transcript.zh_text: 他将坐在轮椅上，在旁听席。

transcript.en_text: Now, if you wanna be on the ground floor, you got to shit or get off the pot.
transcript.zh_text: 如果你想抢占先机，就得赶紧行动，不要拖延。

highlights.en_word: shit or get off the pot

transcript.en_text: The key is to provide leadership, to lead by example.
transcript.zh_text: 关键在于提供领导力，以身作则。

transcript.en_text: I was hoping we could hit Maidstone for a quick eighteen.
transcript.zh_text: 我本来希望我们能去梅德斯通打一场快速的18洞高尔夫。

transcript.en_text: No, I'm a terrible golfer.
transcript.zh_text: 不，我高尔夫打得很差。

transcript.en_text: Exactly, you'd have the pleasure of beating a president.
transcript.zh_text: 没错，你将有幸击败一位总统。

transcript.en_text: Now wouldn't that be a good cocktail story?
transcript.zh_text: 这难道不是一个很好的酒会谈资吗？

transcript.en_text: I've spoken to almost every Republican in your committee, sir.
transcript.zh_text: 先生，我几乎和您委员会里的每一位共和党人都谈过了。

transcript.en_text: Yes, they're taking their cue from you.
transcript.zh_text: 是的，他们都在看你的脸色行事。

transcript.en_text: Is there another number where I can reach him?
transcript.zh_text: 有没有其他号码可以联系到他？

transcript.en_text: It's important that we speak this evening.
transcript.zh_text: 我们今晚谈谈很重要。

transcript.en_text: Yes, anytime, no matter how late.
transcript.zh_text: 是的，随时都可以，不管多晚。

transcript.en_text: A little faith, Tom.
transcript.zh_text: 有点信心，汤姆。

transcript.en_text: That's all I'm asking.
transcript.zh_text: 我只要这些。

transcript.en_text: Oh, yes!
transcript.zh_text: 哦，是的！

transcript.en_text: I know, I don't like being called "ma'am" either.
transcript.zh_text: 我知道，我也不喜欢被人叫“女士”。

transcript.en_text: If I made every decision based on what makes people feel good, I'd be a talk show host, not the president.
transcript.zh_text: 如果我所有决定都只基于让人们感觉良好，那我就是个脱口秀主持人，而不是总统了。

transcript.en_text: Well, I know Admiral Jennings is a good friend of yours, - I can call him personally. - Don't let fear drive you.
transcript.zh_text: 嗯，我知道詹宁斯海军上将是你的好朋友，- 我可以亲自打电话给他。- 别让恐惧支配你。

transcript.en_text: That's not how you run your business, is it?
transcript.zh_text: 你做生意可不是这样的，是吧？

transcript.en_text: I know you've been in my shoes, and sound bites are not who we are.
transcript.zh_text: 我知道你曾身临其境，而花言巧语不是我们的本色。

transcript.en_text: - Penny-wise and pound-foolish. - I'm so sorry, Senator, did I wake you?
transcript.zh_text: - 小处精明，大处糊涂。- 参议员，非常抱歉，我吵醒你了吗？

transcript.en_text: Yes, no, I'll try back again tomorrow.
transcript.zh_text: 是的，不，我明天再打。

transcript.en_text: I can't fault you for being shortsighted.
transcript.zh_text: 我不能怪你目光短浅。

transcript.en_text: I hope you won't fault me for having a long memory.
transcript.zh_text: 我希望你不会因为我记性好而责怪我。

transcript.en_text: Good night!
transcript.zh_text: 晚安！

transcript.en_text: I'm waking people up now.
transcript.zh_text: 我正在把人吵醒。

transcript.en_text: I'll start again in the morning.
transcript.zh_text: 我早上再开始。

transcript.en_text: - How's it looking? - I had to flip a coin?
transcript.zh_text: - 看起来怎么样？- 我得抛硬币吗？

transcript.en_text: I don't know.
transcript.zh_text: 我不知道。

transcript.en_text: - You? - Not a single backer yet.
transcript.zh_text: - 你呢？- 还没有一个支持者。

transcript.en_text: - Not one? - California's still awake.
transcript.zh_text: - 一个都没有？- 加州还没睡。

transcript.en_text: Maybe I'll have better luck out west.
transcript.zh_text: 也许我往西边走运气会更好。

transcript.en_text: I'm going for a run.
transcript.zh_text: 我要去跑步了。

transcript.en_text: I need to do something.
transcript.zh_text: 我需要做点什么。

transcript.en_text: - It's late. - Well, I'm too restless.
transcript.zh_text: - 已经很晚了。- 我太焦躁不安了。

transcript.en_text: Well, I'll be here, singing for my supper.
transcript.zh_text: 那我就会待在这儿，为糊口而奔波。

transcript.en_text: It's humiliating to have to beg from some kid who was on Facebook before his testicles descended, but that's-- Derrick, Francis Underwood.
transcript.zh_text: 向一个在蛋蛋还没发育之前就在玩脸书的小屁孩乞求，这太丢人了，但是——德里克，弗朗西斯·安德伍德。

transcript.en_text: Do you have a few minutes?
transcript.zh_text: 你现在有空吗？

transcript.en_text: I'll be running along the Mall tonight.
transcript.zh_text: 今晚我会在国家广场慢跑。

transcript.en_text: That requires a full detail.
transcript.zh_text: 那需要全面的安保。

transcript.en_text: How soon can you be ready?
transcript.zh_text: 你们多久能准备好？

transcript.en_text: We'd far prefer you ran on the track.
transcript.zh_text: 我们宁愿你在跑道上跑。

transcript.en_text: I'll be running along the Mall.
transcript.zh_text: 我会在国家广场慢跑。

transcript.en_text: Yes, ma'am.
transcript.zh_text: 是的，女士。

transcript.en_text: We're going to need the First Lady's detail, ASAP.
transcript.zh_text: 我们需要第一夫人的安保团队，尽快。

transcript.en_text: - This is off the record. - Agreed.
transcript.zh_text: - 这是非官方的。- 同意。

transcript.en_text: You've called my office every day for the last six months with one question.
transcript.zh_text: 过去六个月你每天都打电话到我办公室，只问一个问题。

transcript.en_text: I call everyone in the leadership.
transcript.zh_text: 我给领导层所有人都打了电话。

transcript.en_text: I get the same non-answer from all of you: "Frank Underwood is our president..." He has our undivided support.
transcript.zh_text: 我从你们所有人那里得到的都是同样的非回答：“弗兰克·安德伍德是我们的总统……”他得到了我们毫无保留的支持。

transcript.en_text: Birch slipped up once.
transcript.zh_text: 伯奇有一次说漏了嘴。

transcript.en_text: He said "unwavering" instead of "undivided." I wanted to drug-test him.
transcript.zh_text: 他说的是“坚定不移的”而不是“毫无保留的”。我想给他做个药检。

transcript.en_text: There was a meeting this morning in the White House.
transcript.zh_text: 今天早上白宫开了一个会。

transcript.en_text: I was there on Pebble Beach when you came out.
transcript.zh_text: 你出来的时候，我正在卵石滩。

transcript.en_text: It lasted four and a half minutes.
transcript.zh_text: 会议持续了四分半钟。

transcript.en_text: - You were in there for an hour. - We were inside for an hour.
transcript.zh_text: - 你在里面待了一个小时。- 我们在里面待了一个小时。

transcript.en_text: Doesn't mean the meeting lasted that long.
transcript.zh_text: 这不代表会议持续了那么久。

transcript.en_text: What happened?
transcript.zh_text: 发生什么事了？

transcript.en_text: Why so short?
transcript.zh_text: 为什么这么短？

transcript.en_text: You're the Pulitzer finalist.
transcript.zh_text: 你是普利策奖的最终入围者。

transcript.en_text: America Works?
transcript.zh_text: 《美国行吗？》

transcript.en_text: Is that why the president went to the Capitol this afternoon?
transcript.zh_text: 这就是总统今天下午去国会大厦的原因吗？

transcript.en_text: No one from the White House would say.
transcript.zh_text: 白宫的人都没有透露。

transcript.en_text: Have a good night.
transcript.zh_text: 晚安。

transcript.en_text: You chose me.
transcript.zh_text: 你选了我。

transcript.en_text: What's your play?
transcript.zh_text: 你有什么打算？

transcript.en_text: When you write about presidents, people pay attention.
transcript.zh_text: 当你写总统相关的事情时，人们会关注。

transcript.en_text: Oh...
Oh!
transcript.zh_text: 哦！

transcript.en_text: Ah...
It'll come down to the wire.
transcript.zh_text: 这会是最后一刻才见分晓。

transcript.en_text: I'm confident, but I don't want to leave anything to chance.
transcript.zh_text: 我有信心，但不想把任何事情都交给运气。

highlights.zh_word: 把任何事情都交给运气

transcript.en_text: Well, according to Erikson, I have 47 votes as of this morning.
transcript.zh_text: 好吧，根据埃里克森的说法，截至今天早上我有47票。

transcript.en_text: Well, I know, Senator, but that's not enough.
transcript.zh_text: 参议员，我知道，但这还不够。

transcript.en_text: I need yours.
transcript.zh_text: 我需要你的（票）。

transcript.en_text: I have every intention of running for president.
transcript.zh_text: 我有意竞选总统。

transcript.en_text: I need to know you two are with me.
transcript.zh_text: 我需要知道你们俩支持我。

transcript.en_text: If you have any doubts, now's the time to let me know.
transcript.zh_text: 如果你有任何疑问，现在就告诉我。

transcript.en_text: Nancy, wipe the schedule clean.
transcript.zh_text: 南希，把日程表清空。

transcript.en_text: Yes, everything.
transcript.zh_text: 是的，全部。

transcript.en_text: We don't leave this office until we have a plan.
transcript.zh_text: 在我们有计划之前，我们不会离开这个办公室。

transcript.en_text: Ma'am?
transcript.zh_text: 夫人？

transcript.en_text: The Easter Egg Roll we were scheduled for?
transcript.zh_text: 我们原定要参加的复活节滚彩蛋活动？

transcript.en_text: - Right. - If this is a bad time...
transcript.zh_text: - 对。- 如果现在不方便的话……

transcript.en_text: No, that's fine.
transcript.zh_text: 不，没关系。

transcript.en_text: Please, come in.
transcript.zh_text: 请进。

transcript.en_text: Hello?
transcript.zh_text: 喂？

transcript.en_text: Yes...
transcript.zh_text: 是的……

transcript.en_text: Claire Underwood.
transcript.zh_text: 克莱尔·安德伍德。

transcript.en_text: He's expecting my call.
transcript.zh_text: 他在等我的电话。

transcript.en_text: Hi, Sheila.
transcript.zh_text: 嗨，希拉。

transcript.en_text: They're beautiful.
transcript.zh_text: 它们很漂亮。

transcript.en_text: Would you mind setting them up, please?
transcript.zh_text: 请你帮我把它们安排一下好吗？

transcript.en_text: I have a couple more calls to make.
transcript.zh_text: 我还有几个电话要打。

transcript.en_text: Hello, Senator.
transcript.zh_text: 您好，参议员。

transcript.en_text: Yes, I'm well.
transcript.zh_text: 是的，我很好。

transcript.en_text: How are you?
transcript.zh_text: 您怎么样？

transcript.en_text: The nomination of Claire Underwood, of Washington DC, to be the Representative of the United States of America to the United Nations.
transcript.zh_text: 克莱尔·安德伍德（来自华盛顿特区）被提名为美利坚合众国驻联合国代表。

transcript.en_text: Yeas and nays have been ordered and the clerk will call the roll.
transcript.zh_text: 赞成票和反对票已下令，书记员将点名。

transcript.en_text: - Mr.
transcript.zh_text: ——先生。

transcript.en_text: Abner. - Yea.
transcript.zh_text: 阿布纳。——赞成。

transcript.en_text: Mr.
transcript.zh_text: 先生。

transcript.en_text: Braun.
transcript.zh_text: 布劳恩。

transcript.en_text: Mr.
transcript.zh_text: 先生。

transcript.en_text: Bray.
transcript.zh_text: 布雷。

transcript.en_text: - This one's a little too pink. - Girls like pink.
transcript.zh_text: ——这个有点太粉了。——女孩子喜欢粉色。

transcript.en_text: This is more than pink.
transcript.zh_text: 这不只是粉色。

transcript.en_text: It's neon.
transcript.zh_text: 是霓虹色。

transcript.en_text: - Uh, I'm choosing four? - Yes, ma'am.
transcript.zh_text: ——呃，我选四个吗？——是的，女士。

transcript.en_text: - Willa? - Up by two: 48 to 46.
- Ma'am, we can finish up later. - No.
transcript.zh_text: ——女士，我们待会儿可以结束。——不。

transcript.en_text: - Uh, what's next? - The commemoratives.
transcript.zh_text: ——呃，接下来是什么？——纪念品。

transcript.en_text: These are really special.
transcript.zh_text: 这些真的很特别。

transcript.en_text: A black egg?
transcript.zh_text: 一个黑色的蛋？

transcript.en_text: - Yes, with patriotic tipping. - It's still a black egg.
transcript.zh_text: - 是的，还有爱国主义的彩头。- 但它仍然是一个黑色的蛋。

transcript.en_text: Engraved with POTUS and FLOTUS signatures.
transcript.zh_text: 上面刻有总统和第一夫人的签名。

transcript.en_text: Ma'am?
transcript.zh_text: 夫人？

transcript.en_text: Final tally: 52 to 48.
transcript.zh_text: 最终票数：52比48。

transcript.en_text: Against.
transcript.zh_text: 反对。

transcript.en_text: - The press? - In the briefing room.
transcript.zh_text: - 媒体吗？- 在简报室里。

transcript.en_text: I'll just be a few minutes.
transcript.zh_text: 我只需要几分钟。

transcript.en_text: Would you mind waiting?
transcript.zh_text: 你介意等一下吗？

transcript.en_text: Not at all, ma'am.
transcript.zh_text: 一点也不，夫人。

transcript.en_text: Hey.
transcript.zh_text: 嘿。

transcript.en_text: I just heard.
transcript.zh_text: 我刚听说。

transcript.en_text: I'm so sorry.
transcript.zh_text: 我很抱歉。

transcript.en_text: The press is waiting.
transcript.zh_text: 媒体在等着呢。

transcript.en_text: Well, they can wait.
transcript.zh_text: 嗯，他们可以等。

transcript.en_text: - Do you want me to come with you? - No.
transcript.zh_text: - 你想让我和你一起去吗？- 不用。

transcript.en_text: I just want to get it over with.
transcript.zh_text: 我只是想快点把它了结。

transcript.en_text: Claire.
transcript.zh_text: 克莱尔。

transcript.en_text: You-- Good morning.
transcript.zh_text: 你——早上好。

transcript.en_text: Naturally, I'm disappointed that the Senate did not confirm my nomination today.
transcript.zh_text: 当然，我很失望参议院今天没有确认我的提名。

transcript.en_text: But I'm very grateful to have been afforded the opportunity.
transcript.zh_text: 但我非常感谢能获得这个机会。

transcript.en_text: I'd be remiss if I did not thank my husband for all the faith and trust he placed in me.
transcript.zh_text: 如果我不感谢我的丈夫对我所寄予的全部信任，那将是我的疏忽。

transcript.en_text: He's always supported me in achieving my goals.
transcript.zh_text: 他一直支持我实现我的目标。

transcript.en_text: I look forward to continued service as First Lady.
transcript.zh_text: 我期待继续以第一夫人的身份服务。

transcript.en_text: Thank you.
transcript.zh_text: 谢谢。

transcript.en_text: Um, let's go with the... green, the blue, and the cream.
transcript.zh_text: 嗯，我们选……绿色、蓝色和米色。

transcript.en_text: And for the rare one?
transcript.zh_text: 那稀有的呢？

transcript.en_text: The Golden Ticket, so to speak?
transcript.zh_text: 所谓“金票”？

transcript.en_text: Red.
transcript.zh_text: 红色。

transcript.en_text: That one's beautiful.
transcript.zh_text: 那个很漂亮。

transcript.en_text: Thank you.
transcript.zh_text: 谢谢。

transcript.en_text: Excuse me, please?
transcript.zh_text: 请问，打扰一下？

transcript.en_text: You ever try to do this?
transcript.zh_text: 你试过这样做吗？

transcript.en_text: Balance an egg?
transcript.zh_text: 平衡一个鸡蛋？

transcript.en_text: We used to do this as kids.
transcript.zh_text: 我们小时候常做这个。

transcript.en_text: You can't change the laws of physics, can you?
transcript.zh_text: 你改变不了物理定律，对吧？

transcript.en_text: I was wrong.
transcript.zh_text: 我错了。

transcript.en_text: It's too hard.
transcript.zh_text: 太难了。

transcript.en_text: Sir?
transcript.zh_text: 先生？

transcript.en_text: Fighting the leadership, raising money.
transcript.zh_text: 与领导层对抗，筹集资金。

transcript.en_text: We can't get them to do what they're dead set against doing.
transcript.zh_text: 我们不能让他们做他们坚决反对的事情。

transcript.en_text: We'd need six months just to get them back to square one.
transcript.zh_text: 我们至少需要六个月才能让他们回到原点。

transcript.en_text: We have to reverse our thinking.
transcript.zh_text: 我们必须逆转思维。

transcript.en_text: When the wind's blowing at gale force, there's no point in sailing against it.
transcript.zh_text: 当风力达到飓风级别时，逆风航行毫无意义。

transcript.en_text: What do you have in mind?
transcript.zh_text: 你有什么想法？

transcript.en_text: The White House Counsel's office, please.
transcript.zh_text: 请转白宫法律顾问办公室。

transcript.en_text: I don't care about their schedules.
transcript.zh_text: 我不在乎他们的日程。

transcript.en_text: If not today, tomorrow morning.
transcript.zh_text: 如果不是今天，那就明天早上。

transcript.en_text: Should I invite Jackie, too?
transcript.zh_text: 我也应该邀请杰基吗？

transcript.en_text: Well, she qualifies as leadership.
transcript.zh_text: 嗯，她有资格作为领导层。

transcript.en_text: - What about her ask? - Stall her for now.
transcript.zh_text: - 她有什么要求？- 先拖住她。

transcript.en_text: Let's see how the meeting goes.
transcript.zh_text: 看看会议进行得如何。

transcript.en_text: I want you to write the speech, every word.
transcript.zh_text: 我要你写这份演讲稿，一字一句。

transcript.en_text: - Yes, sir. - And no leaks.
transcript.zh_text: - 是的，先生。- 不许泄密。

transcript.en_text: You'll have a draft in three hours.
transcript.zh_text: 你会在三小时内拿到草稿。

transcript.en_text: And, sir...
transcript.zh_text: 还有，先生...

transcript.en_text: Doug emailed me a lobbying strategy for AmWorks.
transcript.zh_text: 道格给我发了一份关于AmWorks的游说策略邮件。

transcript.en_text: - Do you want to look at it? - Of his own accord?
transcript.zh_text: - 你想看看吗？- 他自愿的？

transcript.en_text: - You didn't tell him? - No, I didn't say a word.
transcript.zh_text: - 你没告诉他？- 不，我什么都没说。

transcript.en_text: It must be what he gathered from watching the news.
transcript.zh_text: 这一定是他看新闻时收集到的信息。

transcript.en_text: - How is he? - Uh, Doug seems fine.
transcript.zh_text: - 他怎么样？ - 嗯，道格看起来很好。

transcript.en_text: I've been calling him, like you asked.
transcript.zh_text: 我一直在给他打电话，就像你要求的那样。

transcript.en_text: - But he seems all right? - Well, he tells me things are good, although I don't think he'd admit it if they weren't.
transcript.zh_text: - 但他看起来还好吗？ - 嗯，他告诉我一切都好，尽管如果不是这样，我想他也不会承认的。

transcript.en_text: Why don't you stop by from time to time, since I can't.
transcript.zh_text: 既然我不能去，你何不时不时地去看看他呢？

transcript.en_text: - See him in person. - Yes, sir.
transcript.zh_text: - 亲自去见他。 - 是的，先生。

transcript.en_text: And send me his email.
transcript.zh_text: 把他的电子邮件发给我。

transcript.en_text: Claire?
transcript.zh_text: 克莱尔？

transcript.en_text: I'll be in my study if you need me.
transcript.zh_text: 如果你需要我，我就在书房里。

transcript.en_text: What're you working on?
transcript.zh_text: 你在忙什么？

transcript.en_text: - Brought you a coffee. - My savior.
transcript.zh_text: - 给你带了杯咖啡。 - 我的救星。

transcript.en_text: The leadership meeting yesterday morning.
transcript.zh_text: 昨天早上的领导层会议。

transcript.en_text: It lasted four and a half minutes.
transcript.zh_text: 会议持续了四分半钟。

transcript.en_text: Where'd you hear that?
transcript.zh_text: 你是从哪里听说的？

transcript.en_text: That's not long enough to reject a major domestic agenda.
transcript.zh_text: 这么短的时间不足以否决一项重要的国内议程。

transcript.en_text: I wasn't in the meeting.
transcript.zh_text: 我没参加会议。

transcript.en_text: I don't know how long it lasted.
transcript.zh_text: 我不知道持续了多久。

transcript.en_text: - Something went down. - If you say so.
transcript.zh_text: - 出了些事。 - 如果你这么说的话。

transcript.en_text: Uh, I didn't hear anything about it.
transcript.zh_text: 呃，我没听说任何关于它的事。

transcript.en_text: Could've been the president was called away.
transcript.zh_text: 可能是总统被叫走了。

transcript.en_text: - That happens all the time. - Not this time.
transcript.zh_text: - 那是常有的事。 - 这次可不是。

transcript.en_text: How do you know?
transcript.zh_text: 你怎么知道的？

transcript.en_text: Clearly, I have a source that knows more than you.
transcript.zh_text: 显然，我有个比你更清楚的线人。

transcript.en_text: Most sources do.
transcript.zh_text: 大多数线人都是如此。

transcript.en_text: At least they pretend they do.
transcript.zh_text: 至少他们假装如此。

transcript.en_text: Thanks for the coffee.
transcript.zh_text: 谢谢你的咖啡。

transcript.en_text: Two sugars next time.
transcript.zh_text: 下次两勺糖。

transcript.en_text: I'll remember that.
transcript.zh_text: 我记住了。

transcript.en_text: You talked to Ayla Sayyad.
transcript.zh_text: 你和艾拉·萨耶德谈过了。

transcript.en_text: I can either be an asset or a liability.
transcript.zh_text: 我既可以是你的财富，也可以是你的累赘。

transcript.en_text: You think this puts you on the ticket now?
transcript.zh_text: 你觉得这会让你现在加入候选名单吗？

transcript.en_text: Not if you tell him.
transcript.zh_text: 如果你告诉他，就不会。

transcript.en_text: But the smart move would be to advocate on my behalf.
transcript.zh_text: 但明智的做法是替我美言几句。

transcript.en_text: Don't strong-arm me, Jackie.
transcript.zh_text: 别想威胁我，杰基。

transcript.en_text: You're the man in the middle.
transcript.zh_text: 你是中间人。

transcript.en_text: Who else would I strong-arm?
transcript.zh_text: 我不威胁你还威胁谁呢？

transcript.en_text: I want to be on your team, Remy.
transcript.zh_text: 我想加入你的团队，雷米。

transcript.en_text: We do well when we're on the same team.
transcript.zh_text: 我们同心协力时才能做得好。

transcript.en_text: You have more calls?
transcript.zh_text: 你还有电话吗？

transcript.en_text: No.
transcript.zh_text: 没有了。

transcript.en_text: I'm done.
transcript.zh_text: 我做完了。

transcript.en_text: - Who spoke to her? - I have no idea, sir.
transcript.zh_text: - 谁跟她说了？- 我不知道，长官。

transcript.en_text: - Well, it's your job to know. - Things are moving fast.
transcript.zh_text: - 这是你该知道的。- 事情进展很快。

transcript.en_text: I'm just trying to stay ahead of them.
transcript.zh_text: 我只是想抢在他们前面。

transcript.en_text: Well, we need to move faster.
transcript.zh_text: 我们需要更快行动。

transcript.en_text: Has the meeting been set?
transcript.zh_text: 会议定了吗？

transcript.en_text: Eight a.m. tomorrow.
transcript.zh_text: 明天早上八点。

transcript.en_text: I just heard back from Birch's office.
transcript.zh_text: 我刚得到伯奇办公室的回复。

transcript.en_text: Good.
transcript.zh_text: 好的。

transcript.en_text: Let's have the networks ready to go live by nine.
transcript.zh_text: 让我们在九点前让网络准备好直播。

transcript.en_text: One more thing.
transcript.zh_text: 还有一件事。

transcript.en_text: Jackie.
transcript.zh_text: 杰基。

transcript.en_text: I think you should decide sooner rather than later.
transcript.zh_text: 我觉得你最好早点决定。

transcript.en_text: If we're gonna go this route, we need every ally we can get.
transcript.zh_text: 如果我们选择这条路，我们需要一切能争取到的盟友。

transcript.en_text: After the meeting.
transcript.zh_text: 会议之后。

transcript.en_text: We'll discuss then.
transcript.zh_text: 到时再讨论。

transcript.en_text: You've emerged.
transcript.zh_text: 你出现了。

transcript.en_text: Hi.
transcript.zh_text: 嗨。

transcript.en_text: I took a nap.
transcript.zh_text: 我睡了个午觉。

transcript.en_text: Last night was...
transcript.zh_text: 昨晚真是...

transcript.en_text: I didn't get much sleep.
transcript.zh_text: 我没怎么睡好。

transcript.en_text: Me, neither.
transcript.zh_text: 我也是。

transcript.en_text: We're gonna find something for you.
transcript.zh_text: 我们会为你找到些什么的。

transcript.en_text: Some other position, or something as First Lady, I promise.
transcript.zh_text: 找个别的职位，或者当个第一夫人之类的，我保证。

transcript.en_text: I know.
transcript.zh_text: 我知道。

transcript.en_text: - What are you doing up? - I've got to go over my speech.
transcript.zh_text: - 你怎么还没睡？ - 我得复习一下我的演讲稿。

transcript.en_text: It's happening tomorrow night.
transcript.zh_text: 明天晚上就要开始了。

transcript.en_text: What speech?
transcript.zh_text: 什么演讲？

transcript.en_text: It's premature, isn't it?
transcript.zh_text: 现在说还太早了，不是吗？

transcript.en_text: Read on.
transcript.zh_text: 继续读。

transcript.en_text: Yes?
transcript.zh_text: 是吗？

transcript.en_text: Yes.
transcript.zh_text: 是的。

transcript.en_text: Thank you.
transcript.zh_text: 谢谢。

transcript.en_text: Please.
transcript.zh_text: 请。

transcript.en_text: I put a great deal of thought into what you've all asked of me.
transcript.zh_text: 对于你们所有人对我的要求，我深思熟虑了很久。

highlights.en_word: put a great deal of thought into

transcript.en_text: I challenged myself to keep an open mind.
transcript.zh_text: 我强迫自己保持开放的心态。

transcript.en_text: And my decision is: I will not run for president.
transcript.zh_text: 我的决定是：我不会竞选总统。

transcript.en_text: Look, they're thinking it's too good to be true, and it is.
transcript.zh_text: 你看，他们觉得这好得不像真的，而事实也确实如此。

transcript.en_text: I lied in the Oval Office before.
transcript.zh_text: 我以前在椭圆形办公室里撒过谎。

transcript.en_text: I didn't want to take the chance this time.
transcript.zh_text: 这次我不想冒这个险。

transcript.en_text: It's too big a deal to jinx myself.
transcript.zh_text: 这事太大了，我可不敢乌鸦嘴。

transcript.en_text: At nine o'clock tonight, I will announce to the nation my decision.
transcript.zh_text: 今晚九点，我将向全国公布我的决定。

transcript.en_text: What's the catch?
transcript.zh_text: 有什么猫腻？

transcript.en_text: I wanted us to meet here in this room for a reason.
transcript.zh_text: 我想让大家在这里见面是有原因的。

transcript.en_text: For the past five months, my team has sat at this very table, developing America Works.
transcript.zh_text: 过去五个月，我的团队就坐在这张桌子旁，一直在开发“美国工作计划”。

transcript.en_text: You know how much the program means to me, and I want it to mean as much to you.
transcript.zh_text: 你们知道这个项目对我有多重要，我希望它对你们也同样重要。

transcript.en_text: - So there is a catch. - No, an opportunity.
transcript.zh_text: - 所以还是有蹊跷。 - 不，是个机会。

transcript.en_text: Look, we all know the-- All right, let's just say for... argument's sake that this table here represents the next year and a half, all right?
transcript.zh_text: 听着，我们都知道……好吧，咱们就假设为了……讨论方便，这张桌子代表着接下来的一年半时间，好吗？

transcript.en_text: So, this is us right now.
transcript.zh_text: 所以，这代表我们现在。

transcript.en_text: And down there at the end, that's the election.
transcript.zh_text: 而那边的尽头，就是选举。

transcript.en_text: Now, if I did run, I'd spend the next few months fundraising.
transcript.zh_text: 那么，如果我参选，接下来的几个月我就要忙着募款。

transcript.en_text: And then somewhere around here, I'd formally announce.
transcript.zh_text: 然后大概在这儿，我会正式宣布。

transcript.en_text: And then even if I did win the nomination, say, somewhere around here, I'd start to have to face off with a Republican challenger, probably Mendoza.
transcript.zh_text: 即使我赢得了提名，比如说，大概在这儿的时候，我也得开始与一位共和党挑战者对决，很可能是门多萨。

highlights.zh_word: 与一位共和党挑战者对决

transcript.en_text: And then things would get brutal.
transcript.zh_text: 然后事情就会变得残酷起来。

transcript.en_text: Daily, daily events.
transcript.zh_text: 日常，日常的事件。

transcript.en_text: Fending off attacks.
transcript.zh_text: 抵挡攻击。

transcript.en_text: Launching my own.
transcript.zh_text: 发动我自己的（攻击）。

transcript.en_text: And... you're right.
transcript.zh_text: 而且……你是对的。

transcript.en_text: In the end...
transcript.zh_text: 最终……

transcript.en_text: ...I'd probably lose.
transcript.zh_text: ……我可能会输。

transcript.en_text: I would spend 18 months campaigning, which would leave no time to govern.
transcript.zh_text: 我会花18个月去竞选，那就没有时间执政了。

transcript.en_text: But you have opened my eyes.
transcript.zh_text: 但你让我茅塞顿开。

transcript.en_text: I feel liberated.
transcript.zh_text: 我感到解放了。

transcript.en_text: I want to spend these next 18 months dedicated to one thing: America Works.
transcript.zh_text: 我想把未来18个月的时间投入到一件事上：让美国运转起来。

transcript.en_text: But I need your help to do it.
transcript.zh_text: 但我需要你的帮助来完成它。

transcript.en_text: You're putting an awfully big price tag on this, Mr.
transcript.zh_text: 你的要价太高了，先生。

transcript.en_text: President.
transcript.zh_text: 总统。

transcript.en_text: No, you've put an awfully big price tag on this.
transcript.zh_text: 不，是你给这件事标了个天价。

transcript.en_text: You're asking me to be a placeholder for 18 months and I intend to govern.
transcript.zh_text: 你要求我做18个月的“占位符”，而我打算执政。

transcript.en_text: And if America Works succeeds, then whoever you choose to run in 2016 not only has the backing of a united party, but a formidable legacy.
transcript.zh_text: 如果“美国运转”项目成功，那么你在2016年选择的候选人不仅将获得一个团结的政党的支持，还会拥有一份辉煌的遗产。

transcript.en_text: But Social Security?
transcript.zh_text: 但社会保障呢？

transcript.en_text: Benefits.
transcript.zh_text: 福利。

transcript.en_text: Entitlements.
transcript.zh_text: 享有的福利。

transcript.en_text: We don't want to present a fresh face only to shoot ourselves in the foot.
transcript.zh_text: 我们不想推出一个新面孔，结果却搬起石头砸自己的脚。

transcript.en_text: Then let's not pretend to unite the party, let's unite the party behind this legislation.
transcript.zh_text: 那我们就别假装团结党派了，让我们为这项立法而团结起来。

transcript.en_text: We'll never get it past the Republicans.
transcript.zh_text: 我们永远无法让共和党通过它。

transcript.en_text: We are not here to negotiate!
transcript.zh_text: 我们不是来谈判的！

transcript.en_text: You want forward-thinking, Bob?
transcript.zh_text: 你想要超前思维，鲍勃？

transcript.en_text: Then think forward.
transcript.zh_text: 那就向前看。

transcript.en_text: You want a fresh face for 2016?
transcript.zh_text: 你想要2016年的新面孔吗？

transcript.en_text: You wanna work together?
transcript.zh_text: 你想一起合作吗？

transcript.en_text: Then present my program to Congress.
transcript.zh_text: 然后把我的计划提交给国会。

transcript.en_text: And if it dies there, so be it.
transcript.zh_text: 如果它在那里夭折，那就这样吧。

transcript.en_text: But I want us to fucking try!
transcript.zh_text: 但我想我们他妈的要试试！

transcript.en_text: I am prepared to vacate this chair.
transcript.zh_text: 我准备好让出这个位置。

transcript.en_text: Meet me halfway.
transcript.zh_text: 各退一步。

transcript.en_text: Any moment now, the president will be addressing the nation live from the East Room.
transcript.zh_text: 现在随时，总统将从东厅向全国发表直播讲话。

transcript.en_text: The White House has remained silent on the subject of the president's speech, but sources in Congress say it will focus on the jobs initiative he's been planning to unveil for several months.
transcript.zh_text: 白宫对总统演讲的内容一直保持沉默，但国会消息人士称，演讲将重点关注他计划了几个月的就业倡议。

transcript.en_text: The program, dubbed America Works, was developed in secret.
transcript.zh_text: 这项名为“美国工作”的计划是秘密开发的。

transcript.en_text: Any details are the by-product of speculation, but sources suggest it will have elements from both liberal and conservative agendas.
transcript.zh_text: 任何细节都是推测的副产品，但消息人士称，它将包含自由派和保守派议程中的元素。

transcript.en_text: What remains to be seen is whether a Republican-controlled Congress will cooperate in pushing the program forward.
transcript.zh_text: 有待观察的是，由共和党控制的国会是否会合作推动该计划。

transcript.en_text: The White House has faced significant opposition from the GOP since Congress began its current session, and many speculate that the president's liberal application of veto power may leave congressional leaders disinclined to support this new jobs program.
transcript.zh_text: 自国会本届会议开始以来，白宫一直面临共和党的强烈反对，许多人猜测，总统滥用否决权可能会使国会领导人不愿意支持这项新的就业计划。

transcript.en_text: Additionally, many Democratic supporters of President Underwood, from his days as House Majority Whip, were voted out of office in November, diminishing his personal influence over legislators.
transcript.zh_text: 此外，安德伍德总统在担任众议院多数党党鞭时的许多民主党支持者都在11月被投票罢免，这削弱了他对立法者的个人影响力。

highlights.zh_word: 削弱了他的个人影响力

transcript.en_text: Low approval ratings are a continuing concern for the Underwood administration.
transcript.zh_text: 低支持率仍然是安德伍德政府持续关注的问题。

transcript.en_text: And congressional sources suggest the choice to tackle unemployment may be part of a campaign strategy for 2016.
transcript.zh_text: 国会消息人士暗示，选择解决失业问题可能成为2016年竞选策略的一部分。

transcript.en_text: Recent polls indicate that less than one third of all Americans say they would consider voting for President Underwood...
transcript.zh_text: 最近的民意调查显示，不到三分之一的美国人表示会考虑投票给安德伍德总统...

transcript.en_text: ...job growth has remained a popular platform in national elections, and if today's announcement is received well, President Underwood's campaign certainly has an opportunity to benefit.
transcript.zh_text: ...就业增长在全国大选中一直是一个受欢迎的政纲，如果今天的公告反响良好，安德伍德总统的竞选活动肯定有机会从中受益。

transcript.en_text: Thank you.
transcript.zh_text: 谢谢。

transcript.en_text: Sir, we're ready for you in five seconds.
transcript.zh_text: 先生，我们五秒钟后就准备好了。

transcript.en_text: Good evening.
transcript.zh_text: 晚上好。

transcript.en_text: For too long, we in Washington have been lying to you.
transcript.zh_text: 长期以来，我们华盛顿的政客一直在欺骗你们。

transcript.en_text: We say we're here to serve you, when in fact, we're serving ourselves.
transcript.zh_text: 我们说我们在这里为你们服务，但实际上，我们是在服务自己。

transcript.en_text: And why?
transcript.zh_text: 为什么？

transcript.en_text: We are driven by our own desire to get reelected.
transcript.zh_text: 我们被自己连任的欲望所驱使。

transcript.en_text: Our need to stay in power eclipses our duty to govern.
transcript.zh_text: 我们对掌权的渴望盖过了我们治理国家的职责。

transcript.en_text: That ends tonight.
transcript.zh_text: 今晚，这一切都将结束。

transcript.en_text: Tonight, I give you the truth.
transcript.zh_text: 今晚，我将告诉你们真相。

transcript.en_text: And the truth is this: The American dream has failed you.
transcript.zh_text: 真相是：美国梦已经让你们失望了。

transcript.en_text: Work hard?
transcript.zh_text: 努力工作？

transcript.en_text: Play by the rules?
transcript.zh_text: 遵守规则？

transcript.en_text: You aren't guaranteed success.
transcript.zh_text: 成功并不保证属于你。

transcript.en_text: Your children will not have a better life than you did.
transcript.zh_text: 你的孩子不会比你过上更好的生活。

transcript.en_text: Ten million of you can't even get a job, even though you desperately want one.
transcript.zh_text: 一千万人甚至找不到工作，尽管你们非常渴望一份工作。

transcript.en_text: We've been crippled by Social Security, Medicare, Medicaid, by welfare, by entitlements.
transcript.zh_text: 我们被社会保障、医疗保险、医疗补助、福利和福利制度所拖累。

transcript.en_text: And that is the root of the problem: entitlements.
transcript.zh_text: 这就是问题的根源：福利制度。

transcript.en_text: Let me be clear.
transcript.zh_text: 让我把话说清楚。

transcript.en_text: You are entitled to nothing.
transcript.zh_text: 你们什么都不配拥有。

transcript.en_text: You are entitled to nothing.
transcript.zh_text: 你们什么都不配拥有。

transcript.en_text: America was built on the spirit of industry.
transcript.zh_text: 美国建立在勤奋进取的精神之上。

transcript.en_text: You build your future.
transcript.zh_text: 你们要自己创造未来。

transcript.en_text: It isn't handed to you.
transcript.zh_text: 这并非白送给你的。

transcript.en_text: And the problem with Washington is that we haven't given you the tools to build it.
transcript.zh_text: 华盛顿的问题在于，我们没有给你提供建造它的工具。

transcript.en_text: The only way for us to serve you is to give you the means to serve yourselves.
transcript.zh_text: 我们服务你的唯一方式是给你提供自我服务的手段。

transcript.en_text: Well, that's exactly what I intend to do.
transcript.zh_text: 嗯，这正是我打算做的。

transcript.en_text: Not handouts.
transcript.zh_text: 不是施舍。

transcript.en_text: Jobs.
transcript.zh_text: 工作。

transcript.en_text: Real paying jobs.
transcript.zh_text: 真正有报酬的工作。

transcript.en_text: In the next few weeks, the Democratic leadership will introduce a program called "America Works." Its goal is simple: to put the ten million Americans who are unemployed to work.
transcript.zh_text: 在接下来的几周，民主党领导层将推出一项名为“美国就业计划”的项目。它的目标很简单：让一千万失业的美国人找到工作。

highlights.en_word: to put the ten million Americans who are unemployed to work
highlights.zh_word: 让一千万失业的美国人找到工作

transcript.en_text: All of them.
transcript.zh_text: 所有这些人。

transcript.en_text: If you want a job, you get one.
transcript.zh_text: 如果你想要一份工作，你就能得到一份。

transcript.en_text: The cost is five hundred billion dollars.
transcript.zh_text: 费用是五千亿美元。

transcript.en_text: Now, that's a lot of money.
transcript.zh_text: 好了，那可是一大笔钱。

transcript.en_text: To pay for it, we'll need to rethink Social Security, healthcare and benefits from the ground up.
transcript.zh_text: 为了支付这笔费用，我们需要从头开始重新思考社会保障、医疗保健和福利。

transcript.en_text: We can't maintain the welfare state as we know it.
transcript.zh_text: 我们不能再维持我们所知的福利国家了。

transcript.en_text: Now, that's not a popular thing to say.
transcript.zh_text: 好了，这不是一句受欢迎的话。

transcript.en_text: Anyone running for office wouldn't dare utter those words.
transcript.zh_text: 任何竞选公职的人都不敢说出那些话。

transcript.en_text: Every advisor and consultant and staff member would beg a presidential candidate not to say them.
transcript.zh_text: 每一位顾问、咨询师和工作人员都会恳求总统候选人不要说出这些话。

transcript.en_text: But I can say them.
transcript.zh_text: 但我可以说这些话。

transcript.en_text: Because I will not be seeking the Democratic nomination in 2016.
transcript.zh_text: 因为我不会寻求2016年民主党总统候选人提名。

highlights.zh_word: 寻求民主党总统候选人提名

transcript.en_text: Candidates are cautious.
transcript.zh_text: 候选人都很谨慎。

transcript.en_text: They must equivocate.
transcript.zh_text: 他们必须含糊其辞。

transcript.en_text: They dodge and tiptoe.
transcript.zh_text: 他们闪烁其词、小心翼翼。

transcript.en_text: But I'd rather leave this office having accomplished something of value than secure another four years having done nothing at all.
transcript.zh_text: 但我宁愿带着有所成就的价值离开这个职位，也不愿在碌碌无为的情况下再争取四年任期。

transcript.en_text: Franklin Delano Roosevelt ushered in an era of hope and progress when he proposed the New Deal.
transcript.zh_text: 富兰克林·德拉诺·罗斯福提出“新政”时，开启了一个充满希望和进步的时代。

transcript.en_text: And at the time, his reforms were considered radical.
transcript.zh_text: 当时，他的改革被认为是激进的。

transcript.en_text: But he once said, "This country demands bold, persistent experimentation.
transcript.zh_text: 但他曾说过：“这个国家需要大胆而持久的试验。

transcript.en_text: It is common sense to take a method and try it.
transcript.zh_text: 采取一种方法并尝试它是常识。

transcript.en_text: And if it fails, admit it frankly and try another.
transcript.zh_text: 如果失败了，坦率承认并尝试另一种方法。

transcript.en_text: But above all, try something." Roosevelt would have understood better than anyone the necessity for trying something different.
transcript.zh_text: 但最重要的是，要尝试一些东西。”罗斯福会比任何人都更理解尝试不同事物的必要性。

transcript.en_text: The New Deal succeeded for many years, but we must now try something newer before it fails us.
transcript.zh_text: “新政”成功了多年，但我们现在必须尝试一些更新的东西，以免它辜负我们。

transcript.en_text: If America Works succeeds, we will reinvent the American dream.
transcript.zh_text: 如果“美国行动”成功，我们将重塑美国梦。

transcript.en_text: If we fail in our attempt, we will admit it frankly and try another.
transcript.zh_text: 如果我们的尝试失败了，我们会坦率承认并尝试另一种方法。

transcript.en_text: But above all, we must try something.
transcript.zh_text: 但最重要的是，我们必须尝试一些东西。

transcript.en_text: Thank you, and God Bless the United States of America.
transcript.zh_text: 谢谢，愿上帝保佑美利坚合众国。

transcript.en_text: Hey.
transcript.zh_text: 嘿。

transcript.en_text: It's two in the morning.
transcript.zh_text: 现在是凌晨两点。

transcript.en_text: Yeah, I just left the White House.
transcript.zh_text: 是的，我刚离开白宫。

transcript.en_text: The press conference, phone calls, emails, the rest can wait until tomorrow.
transcript.zh_text: 新闻发布会、电话、电子邮件，剩下的都可以等到明天。

transcript.en_text: - Were you asleep? - No.
transcript.zh_text: - 你睡着了吗？ - 没有。

transcript.en_text: This is a cool place.
transcript.zh_text: 这是个很酷的地方。

transcript.en_text: How much is your rent?
transcript.zh_text: 你的房租是多少？

transcript.en_text: I thought you said AmWorks was on hold.
transcript.zh_text: 我以为你说AmWorks暂停了。

transcript.en_text: Well, it was and then it wasn't.
transcript.zh_text: 嗯，它之前是暂停了，后来又不是了。

transcript.en_text: The leadership didn't want him to run.
transcript.zh_text: 领导层不希望他参选。

transcript.en_text: Who told you that?
transcript.zh_text: 谁告诉你的？

transcript.en_text: Nobody.
transcript.zh_text: 没人。

transcript.en_text: But I figure it's the only reason he'd make that speech.
transcript.zh_text: 但我猜，这是他发表那次演讲的唯一原因。

transcript.en_text: Hm...
- He's still gonna run though, isn't he? - He says he's not.
transcript.zh_text: - 他还是会参选的，不是吗？ - 他说他不会。

transcript.en_text: I know him better than you ever will, Seth.
transcript.zh_text: 塞斯，我比你更了解他。

transcript.en_text: There's no way he doesn't run.
transcript.zh_text: 他不可能不参选。

transcript.en_text: Is that why you're here?
transcript.zh_text: 你就是因为这个才来的吗？

transcript.en_text: Because he needs my help now?
transcript.zh_text: 因为他现在需要我的帮助吗？

transcript.en_text: No, I just-- I wanted to check up with you in person this time.
transcript.zh_text: 不，我只是——这次我想亲自来找你确认一下。

transcript.en_text: - He asked you to. - Yes.
transcript.zh_text: - 他让你来的。 - 是的。

transcript.en_text: I did send him your email, though.
transcript.zh_text: 不过，我确实把你的邮件发给他了。

transcript.en_text: - What did he say? - I'm not sure if he's read it.
transcript.zh_text: - 他说什么了？ - 我不确定他是否看了。

transcript.en_text: You should probably get some sleep, huh?
transcript.zh_text: 你大概应该睡会儿了，嗯？

transcript.en_text: Big day for the press team tomorrow.
transcript.zh_text: 明天对新闻团队来说是个大日子。

transcript.en_text: You can report back.
transcript.zh_text: 你可以汇报情况。

transcript.en_text: Alive and well.
transcript.zh_text: 活得好好的。

transcript.en_text: Is it okay if I stop by now and then?
transcript.zh_text: 我偶尔过来一下行吗？

transcript.en_text: Do I have a choice?
transcript.zh_text: 我有的选吗？

transcript.en_text: I don't, but I can't force you to open the door.
transcript.zh_text: 我没有，但我不能强迫你开门。

highlights.en_word: force you to open the door

transcript.en_text: - Whatever you want. - Thanks.
transcript.zh_text: - 你想怎样就怎样吧。 - 谢谢。

transcript.en_text: I'll see you soon.
transcript.zh_text: 我很快就会见到你。

transcript.en_text: Ms.
transcript.zh_text: 女士。

transcript.en_text: Dunbar.
transcript.zh_text: 邓巴。

transcript.en_text: Mr.
transcript.zh_text: 先生。

transcript.en_text: President.
transcript.zh_text: 总统。

transcript.en_text: I had a lot on my mind when we last spoke.
transcript.zh_text: 上次我们谈话时，我心事重重。

highlights.en_word: had a lot on my mind

transcript.en_text: - The speech last night, it was-- - Yes, it was a big decision and I apologize if I was distracted.
transcript.zh_text: - 昨晚的演讲，它很—— - 是的，那是一个重大决定，如果我心不在焉，我道歉。

transcript.en_text: - Not at all, sir. - So, the drone strike case.
transcript.zh_text: - 完全没有，先生。 - 那么，无人机袭击案。

transcript.en_text: You've been pursuing the State secrets defense.
transcript.zh_text: 你一直在寻求国家机密抗辩。

transcript.en_text: Yes, sir.
transcript.zh_text: 是的，先生。

transcript.en_text: - Heather-- May I call you Heather? - Please.
transcript.zh_text: - 海瑟—— 我可以叫你海瑟吗？ - 请便。

transcript.en_text: The American people are sick of secrets.
transcript.zh_text: 美国人民已经厌倦了秘密。

transcript.en_text: That's the point I was trying to make last night.
transcript.zh_text: 那是我昨晚想表达的观点。

highlights.en_word: the point I was trying to make

transcript.en_text: I promised the truth, and now we're going to deliver.
transcript.zh_text: 我承诺了真相，现在我们要兑现。

transcript.en_text: What truth is that, sir?
transcript.zh_text: 那是什么真相，先生？

transcript.en_text: A man had his legs blown off.
transcript.zh_text: 一个人被炸断了双腿。

transcript.en_text: An American citizen.
transcript.zh_text: 一名美国公民。

transcript.en_text: We're going to own up to that.
transcript.zh_text: 我们会对此负责。

transcript.en_text: We're going to admit that the CIA conducted the drone strike - and explain the reasons why. - That information is classified.
transcript.zh_text: 我们将承认中情局实施了无人机袭击——并解释原因。——那份情报是机密的。

transcript.en_text: Not anymore.
transcript.zh_text: 不再是了。

transcript.en_text: You have my permission to make the classified brief public.
transcript.zh_text: 我授权你将这份机密简报公开。

transcript.en_text: Sir, that is not a sound legal approach.
transcript.zh_text: 先生，那不是一个明智的法律策略。

transcript.en_text: - But it's what the country needs. - We're not appealing to the country.
transcript.zh_text: 但这是国家需要的。——我们不是在向国家求情。

transcript.en_text: - We're appealing to nine justices. - Wrong.
transcript.zh_text: 我们是在向九位大法官陈情。——错了。

transcript.en_text: We're appealing to both by taking responsibility.
transcript.zh_text: 我们通过承担责任来同时争取两者。

transcript.en_text: Yes, a man was maimed, his family members were killed.
transcript.zh_text: 是的，一个人受了重伤，他的家人被杀了。

transcript.en_text: But hundreds, perhaps thousands of lives were saved as a result.
transcript.zh_text: 但结果是，数百甚至数千人的生命得以挽救。

transcript.en_text: I understand the emotional logic, - but we can't-- - You sat right there and told me - even Supreme Court justices have hearts. - Yes, but-- Far be it from me to tell you how to do your job.
transcript.zh_text: 我理解情感逻辑，——但我们不能——你坐在那里告诉我——即使最高法院大法官也有心。——是的，但是——我可不敢教你如何工作。

transcript.en_text: I've never practiced law a day in my life.
transcript.zh_text: 我这辈子一天法都没学过。

transcript.en_text: But I have written them.
transcript.zh_text: 但我写过法律。

transcript.en_text: And occupying this office, I know what the country needs.
transcript.zh_text: 而身居此职，我知道这个国家需要什么。

transcript.en_text: It needs closure.
transcript.zh_text: 它需要一个了结。

transcript.en_text: Let me work on a new argument.
transcript.zh_text: 让我来研究一个新的论点。

transcript.en_text: - Thank you, Heather. - Thank you, Mr.
transcript.zh_text: 谢谢你，希瑟。——谢谢你，先生。

transcript.en_text: President.
transcript.zh_text: 总统。

transcript.en_text: - Where do you want these, ma'am? - Anywhere.
transcript.zh_text: ——太太，这些您想放哪？——随便放哪都行。

transcript.en_text: Just not in here.
transcript.zh_text: 别放这儿就行。

transcript.en_text: Okay.
transcript.zh_text: 好的。

transcript.en_text: - Scott? - Yes?
transcript.zh_text: ——斯科特？——什么事？

transcript.en_text: Here's a couple more.
transcript.zh_text: 这里还有几个。

transcript.en_text: Hey.
transcript.zh_text: 嘿。

transcript.en_text: You want a peanut butter and jelly?
transcript.zh_text: 要来份花生酱果酱三明治吗？

transcript.en_text: No, thanks.
transcript.zh_text: 不用了，谢谢。

transcript.en_text: Is everything all right?
transcript.zh_text: 一切都还好吗？

transcript.en_text: I want the UN job, Francis.
transcript.zh_text: 弗朗西斯，我想要那个联合国的工作。

transcript.en_text: The Senate goes home in two weeks.
transcript.zh_text: 参议院两周后就要休会了。

transcript.en_text: I want a recess appointment.
transcript.zh_text: 我想要一个休会期间的任命。

transcript.en_text: I prepared for it.
transcript.zh_text: 我为此做了准备。

transcript.en_text: I can do this.
transcript.zh_text: 我能做到。

transcript.en_text: And after it's all over, if I've done the job I know I can do, I'll be positioned - for anything I want. - Claire-- Now, I checked with the White House Counsel.
transcript.zh_text: 等这一切都结束了，如果我能像我相信的那样完成这份工作，我就会处于一个有利的位置，做任何我想做的事。——克莱尔——我查过了白宫法律顾问。

highlights.zh_word: 处于一个有利的位置，做

transcript.en_text: There is precedent for a recess appointment after a rejected nomination.
transcript.zh_text: 被否决的提名之后进行休会任命，是有先例的。

transcript.en_text: Only once, but you wouldn't be the first.
transcript.zh_text: 虽然只有一次，但你不会是第一个。

transcript.en_text: And I know you'll take a hit politically.
transcript.zh_text: 我知道你会在政治上受到打击。

transcript.en_text: And I know people will think I don't deserve it.
transcript.zh_text: 我知道人们会觉得我不配。

transcript.en_text: They'll have doubts in me.
transcript.zh_text: 他们会对我有疑虑。

transcript.en_text: But what if... this is as far as we get?
transcript.zh_text: 但如果……我们就到此为止了呢？

transcript.en_text: What if it's all over in 18 months?
transcript.zh_text: 如果18个月后一切都结束了呢？

transcript.en_text: I don't want to wait, or settle for something else, - when I've put all this work into-- - Okay.
transcript.zh_text: 我不想等待，也不想将就别的，尤其是在我投入了这么多心血之后。- 好吧。

transcript.en_text: I'll do it.
transcript.zh_text: 我来做。

transcript.en_text: - You sure you don't want half? - I'm not hungry.
transcript.zh_text: - 你确定不要一半吗？ - 我不饿。

transcript.en_text: I'll be in my study.
transcript.zh_text: 我会在书房里。
